caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, technical line sketch of a sideboard, captioned with black ink on a light beige background. The sideboard is shown from the front and side views, with dimensions labeled in inches: 71 inches wide and 28 1/2 inches deep, and 42 1/2 inches high. The front view displays four tapered legs, two narrow drawers at the top, one wide drawer below the left-hand drawer, and two cabinet doors to the right, each with outlined decorative panels. The hardware for the drawers and the center of the wider drawer are shown as half-moon shaped handles with a detailed pattern. Above the sideboard in the sketch, a round dish filled with fruit is depicted, likely as a decorative embellishment. The side view illustrates the thickness of the top and side, as well as the curving profile of the base. Text at the top provides details about the designer, location, and approximate date: "Sideboard, Sheraton, Mahogany, Designed & Made by Matthew Egerton, New Brunswick, N.J. ca. 1795." Additional text specifies the seller "Ginsburg & Levy, 815 Madison Ave. N.Y.C," and identifies this as "Stock No. 15314." The draftsman’s name “J.F. Rust” and the scale "1 1/2” = 1 ft." are inscribed at the bottom. The entire drawing and all annotations are monochromatic, using black ink on the beige paper.
title: Sideboard
